name: Ember Depth Reveal
description: Full-screen WebGPU image with a depth map: the picture shifts with the pointer while a glowing ember dot scan sweeps through its depth layers, with a bloom glow and an animated title over it.
contents: Full-screen WebGPU canvas showing a texture with a depth map
Title split by word and a subtitle line over the canvas
Loader overlay with a pinging dot shown until textures load
behavior: Pointer movement offsets the image by depth for a parallax effect
A looping scan reveals glowing dots at the current depth level
Loader fades out, then title words slide down and subtitle slides up

props.name: subtitle
props.default: The Majesty and Glory of the Young King

editableByProps: Image and depth map sources, plane size
Parallax strength, dot tiling, scan speed and dot color
fixed: Needs a depth map image that matches the main image
Loader overlay is position fixed over the viewport until textures load
Uses the Tomorrow font loaded through next/font/google, so it needs Next.js
